# routeros_port_remote_access (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (String) Name of the `/port` entry that is made remotely accessible, for example `serial0`.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `channel` (Number) Channel of the serial port that is exported.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ip_port` (Number) TCP or UDP port number the router listens on, or connects to when `protocol=tcp-client`.
- `local_address` (String) Local address the service binds to.
- `log_file` (String) Name of the file the data exchanged over the port is logged to.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol used to carry the serial data:
  * rfc2217 - Telnet Com Port Control Option, the remote side can also change the line settings,
  * tcp-server - the router listens for a raw TCP connection,
  * tcp-client - the router connects to a remote raw TCP server,
  * udp - raw data over UDP.
- `remote_addresses` (String) Comma separated list of addresses that are allowed to connect to the port, or the address to connect to when `protocol=tcp-client`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
